mechanism_comparison.classical_mechanism: Uniform expansion or positive expansivity says distinct states in an expanding dynamical system cannot remain uniformly close under all forward iterates.
mechanism_comparison.local_mechanism: Modulo the integers, the carries vanish. If every late state is within 1/(B+1) of an integer, successive nearest-integer lifts have an integer discrepancy of absolute value below one, hence zero; the lift errors then multiply by P_n>=2 and boundedness forces the initial error to vanish.
mechanism_comparison.source_wiring: For #269, the suffix-product telescope explains the block-height quotient formula, the quadratic Bellman identity and cap-composition lemmas discharge the shell-cap bookkeeping, all-scale smooth-shell factorization supplies the four-symbol radix and ordered integer digit, summability supplies the genuine infinite tail, and the recurrence feeds the B=30 dichotomy. These are subordinate inputs and consumers of one theorem stack, not separate novelty objects.
mechanism_comparison.exact_delta: The local result computes an optimal alphabet-uniform lift radius and supplies a two-cycle attaining equality for every B>=2.
mechanism_comparison.significance_boundary: The result forces a dichotomy only. It gives neither eventual escape nor a method for excluding the exact integral branch.
